resources.string: Installs and controls the TAK Beacon position reporter, and shares this ATAK\'s server connection with it.
Send a server to TAK Beacon
Gives TAK Beacon the connection ATAK uses, with its certificates, so the beacon reports to the same server under your callsign.
While ATAK is open, TAK Beacon can pause so you are not on the map twice. Turn it on in TAK Beacon: Settings, ATAK.
How to install, connect and use TAK Beacon
